lastMessage:
Phase 2A+B: Auto-detect widget versions + reorganize widgets into categories

Phase 2A: Auto-Version Detection
- Removed explicit version props from 7 page components
- Components now auto-detect latest version automatically
- No more manual version tracking in code
- Updated: concerts.tsx, journalism.tsx, events.tsx, nature.tsx, podcast.tsx, featured-work.tsx, portraits.tsx

Phase 2B: Widget Reorganization
- Created 3 new category directories: portfolios/, _navigation/, _content/
- Reorganized 18 widgets into categorical structure:
  * portfolios/: 7 portfolio widgets (concert, event, featured, nature, photojournalism, portrait, video)
  * _navigation/: 2 navigation widgets (site-footer, site-navigation)
  * _content/: 10 content widgets (about, accessibility-statement, blog-feed, contact-form, hero-slideshow, hire-to-unlock-resume, podcast-feed, policies-legal, testimonials)
- Updated widget config with category properties
- Updated all page components to use category prop

Testing & Validation:
- Tested API endpoint: /api/widgets/portfolios/concert-portfolio → 200 OK
- Verified auto-detection: v4.7.1 correctly identified as latest
- Confirmed backward compatibility: old flat paths still work
- All widgets loading correctly in dev site

Documentation:
- Added PHASE-2-COMPLETE.md (detailed completion summary)
- Added PHASE-2-DEPLOYMENT-CHECKLIST.md (deployment guide)
- Existing: PHASE-2-QUICK-REFERENCE.md, PHASE-2-QUICK-START.md, API-ENDPOINT-REFERENCE.md

Status: Production ready, zero breaking changes, fully backward compatible"
